 Versus

 Order

1) The petitioner (husband) has filed these transfer petitions seeking transfer of Criminal Case bearing No. 80/2024, titled Neha Tomar Vs. Ritesh @ Akash and others, filed under Sections 498A, 406 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending before the Ld. Civil Judge (Junior Division) F.T.C.- 01, Ghaziabad and Criminal Misc. Case/1677/2024 (CNR No.UPGZ040271892024), titled Neha Tomar Vs. Ritesh @ Akash and others filed under Sections 12, 18, 19, 20 and 22 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005,
pending before the Court of Ld. ACJ (Sr. Div.)-4/ ACJM, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh to the Court of Metropolitan Magistrate, Karkardooma Court, District Shahdara, New Delhi.

2) We have heard learned Counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for respondent no.1 (wife),
who appears through video conference and learned counsel for the respondent no.2- State of Uttar Pradesh.
As consented by learned counsel for the parties, the matters are transferred to the Patiala House Courts, New Delhi.

3) Accordingly, Criminal Case bearing No. 80/2024, titled Neha Tomar Vs. Ritesh @ Akash and others, pending before the Ld. Civil Judge (Junior Division) F.T.C.-01, Ghaziabad Magistrate and Criminal Misc. Case/1677/2024 (CNR No.UPGZ040271892024), titled Neha Tomar Vs. Ritesh @
Akash and others filed under Sections 12, 18, 19, 20 and 22 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, pending before the Court of Ld. ACJ (Sr. Div.)-4/ ACJM, Ghaziabad,
Uttar Pradesh are ordered to be transferred to the Court of Metropolitan Magistrate, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi.
4) It is on the discretion of the transferee Court to allow the presence of the petitioner (husband)
and respondent no.1 (wife) virtually until necessarily required and directed.
